description.narrative: (Kosovo): The Compete activity will help make Kosovo more competitive in key sectors, promote economic growth, and encourage regional and global market integration to ultimately generate employment. This activity will build on previous efforts to improve product quality and quantity and take a market systems approach to facilitate opportunities for private businesses to access high-value export markets in the region and Europe. Interventions will improve and coordinate the overall market system and actors while collaborating with the Government of Kosovo to enable a conducive environment for trade. Support will align public and private sector incentives so that food safety, product standards, and certifications meet the requirements of high-value markets. Assistance will build on previous achievements and support targeted marketing opportunities, adapt, or develop products to meet the required standards in targeted markets, and organize events to promote Kosovan products to establish business-to-business contacts with foreign buyers and diaspora businesses. This activity aligns with ICS objective 3.1: Enhanced engagement and policy enactment in trade, regional economic integration, and private sector competitiveness helps Kosovo take ownership of its own prosperity. In addition, it aligns withJRS Goal 2.2: Support inclusive and sustainable economic growth and opportunity for communities around the globe by helping the private sector take a leading role in boosting economic growth and employment in Kosovo through a more competitive private sector. This activity also aligns with CAATSA #8 (5%) through technical assistance in promoting the diversification of exports and improving competitiveness.
